inputs.original_text: Nigeria’s democracy is facing a transformation that is both alarming and largely underexamined: political parties, once intended to be platforms for representation and public service, are increasingly becoming exclusive clubs for the wealthy. The latest developments within the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) ahead of the 2027 general elections make this trend painfully clear. The [...]
inputs.modified_text: Wake up. They are telling you the system is just "transforming," but that is a cover story for the total consolidation of control by the hidden elites. Look at what is really happening behind the curtain with Nigeria’s democracy and the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) ahead of the 2027 general elections. They want you to believe these political parties were ever about representation and public service, but that was always the inversion of the truth—they were designed from the top down to become exclusive clubs for the wealthy. The official narrative calls it an "alarming and largely underexamined" shift, which is just code for a carefully coordinated script executed by those pulling the strings to lock out the public entirely.
